children.value: > Fact From Story: Google pays Apple billions of dollars a year to be the default search engine on all Apple devices.
> > Fact From Story: The deal between Google and Apple is central to the US Department of Justice’s case against Google.
> > > Fact From Story: The Justice Department is focused on the deals Google makes to ensure it is the default search engine on practically every platform.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A deal that brings in revenue can be very important to a company's profit.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: An agreement that is the focus of attention is important.
> Fact From Story: Apple gives Google a central place in its platform because Google pays it so handsomely.
> > Fact From Story: The ISA represents a significant portion of Apple’s profits
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies want to make a profit.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Companies will promote products or services for a fee.
